text:
The loop is close to unstable at heavy load: undershoot is 0.62 V and residual ringing is 0.10 V p-p. The adaptive tail draws about 94 µA at 5 mA load, which pushes the error-amp unity-gain frequency past the output/gate non-dominant pole.

The topology and DC point are correct, and all other specs pass with margin. So I'll refine the parameters rather than edit the program:
- **Ks:** start at 150 (up from 60) and allow up to 800, to weaken the adaptive bias. Sensitivities say +10% Ks gives −29% ringing and −7.6% undershoot.
- **Cc:** start at 24 pF and allow up to 60 pF.
- **Lea:** start at 0.5 µm and allow down to 0.3 µm, since larger Lea worsens ringing.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Near-instability at heavy load: adaptive tail (Ks=60) pushes error-amp UGF past the output/gate pole, causing 0.1 V ringing and large undershoot. Sensitivities show higher Ks, larger Cc, shorter Lea all help; DC point and other specs are fine, so widen those bounds and search.",
 "params": {"Ks": 150.0, "Cc": 24e-12, "Lea": 0.5},
 "bounds": {"Ks": [60.0, 800.0], "Cc": [8e-12, 60e-12], "Lea": [0.3, 1.2]}}
```
